en: <CLT=cltSYSTEM>*ding dong ding dong!*

The intercom? This early in the morning?
I wonder who it could be...

L-Let's hurry and stop Angie, so we 
can put an end to all this spooky stuff!

If things get any scarier, I'll seriously 
die from a heart attack!

I can't believe someone your age would hide
in bed because they're afraid of ghosts...

W-Well, y'know... This is...uh, just how 
my body is. Can't do anything about it...

So you can stand to be around assassins,
but ghosts are where you draw the line?

I've been told that I'm scarier than any
ghost.
Huh? I'm not scared of you at all.

Didn't I tell you? You're just a weak coward.
And you just started your training.
You, of all people, don't get to call me weak.

Sh-Shut up!
Let's go and stop Angie!

...Let's bring Kaito to Angie before he
passes out in terror.

<CLT=cltMIND>This early in the morning?
I wonder who it could be...
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

What's with that face...?
You look like you just woke up.

...I *did* just wake up.
The announcement was just a minute ago.
You wake up to *that*?

If you rely on that announcement as your alarm
clock, you'll start getting used to this place.
Well, I suppose that's true...
It's fine. Let's just go stop the ritual.
K-Kaito?

I heard from Maki Roll. It seems like Angie's
gonna do the ritual.

Maki Roll...? Don't give me such a weird
nickname.
You brought Kaito here, Maki?

...Is that weird? We need a backup plan in
case the straightforward approach fails.

Who better than Kaito for a...less than
straightforward approach?
But, Kaito...are you feeling okay?

Heh, we don't have time to be worrying 
about me.

We gotta put a stop to this ridiculous
"<CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrecting the dead<CLT=cltNORMAL>" crap...

And then...we can finally drop that topic.
Or else...I'm not gonna last...

<CLT=cltMIND>Not gonna last?
Kaito...are you...
Scared?
Huh?

Ah, it's just that I remember that you
don't like talking about ghosts and stuff...

Now that I think about it, you've
been acting strange ever since...

we started talking about
<CLT=cltSTRONG>resurrecting the dead<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

D-D-Don't be stupid!
Th-There's no way!
Ah. So I was right.

Wait... You mean the reason you didn't come
to training is because you were scared?

I-It's not that I'm scared...
That's just how my body is.

I'm fine when it comes to cramped areas, space,
and zero gravity, but...ghost stories...

Since I was a kid, whenever I hear them...
I start to feel sick...

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito was looking more and more pale
as he spoke...

Cuz of that...I haven't been able to eat or 
sleep since all this crap started...
So that's what happened...

So...let's hurry and stop Angie, so we 
can put an end to all this spooky stuff!

If things get any scarier, I'll seriously 
die from a heart attack!
Wh-Why are you looking at me like that?

Unbelievable... You always act like you're
not afraid of anything.

Sh-Shut up!
Let's...just go stop Angie already!

C'mon, bro! C'mon, Maki Roll!
Hurry up!
Seriously...don't call me Maki Roll.
A-Anyway...let's go to Angie's lab.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
There's nothing on the screen.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a normal bed.
It was pretty comfortable.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>Do they plan for us to wear this forever?
It makes it easier to tell us apart, I suppose...
